main_text.p: Philosophia qualitatis est prima, vel orta.
Prima est Physica. Orta est Astronomia, Musica & Optica.
Actionis philosophia est, quæ regit mores, & vitam.
Publica est, aut obsequendi, aut imperandi ars.

Agens est Agricultura: faciens, Architectonica. Hæc vide apud Snellium in prolegom. Ethic. Sunt & alii Ramei, qui retinent divisionem Platonicam, quâ philosophia hercifcitur in ἐγκύκλιον παιδείαν ἢ παιδείαν.

ἐγκύκλιος παιδείαἐγκύκλιος παιδεία philosophica. est præparatio quædam ad philosophandum, & quasi instrumentum, cujus species sunt artes Logica, Dialectica, Grammatica, & Rhetorica: & Mathematica, Arithmetica scil. & Geometria. Suidas vocat τὰ πρῶτα μαθήματα, alii ἐγκύκλια μαθήματα.

Παιδεία, ipsa est philosophia; cujus species sunt, Physica & Ethica. Historia vero & Poësis earum sunt illustrationes. Continent enim exempla de meteoris, sideribus, plantis, item morum, i.e. virtutum & vitiorum.παιδεία philosophica.
main_text.head: Cap. 13. Technologia authoris.
main_text.p: SIc ergo maturandi judicii causâ diversorum authorum sententias commemoravimus de philosophiæ partibus & membris: superest, ut nostram sententiam adferamus.Technolo-gia autho-ris.

page.notes: The Greek words in the margin and text are set in a Greek type that is hard to read at this scan size; the Greek readings are best approximations and need checking against the original (the forms ἐγκύκλιος παιδεία and ἐγκύκλια μαθήματα are reconstructed). Ornamental band between the paragraphs is not text. Marginal notes: "ἐγκύκλιος παιδεία philosophica." and "παιδεία philosophica." on the left; "Technologia authoris." on the left, broken over three lines. The "Ethic." before the italic sentence stands in the text column, not the margin.
